Siaulenai Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Šiauliai County, Lithuania

Not demolished. Siaulenai's mid-17th-century synagogue was one of the oldest in Lithuania, with a beautifully carved wooden Holy Ark. By June 1941, only twenty Jewish families remained in the town; that September they were transferred to Žagarė, documented elsewhere in this collection, and massacred alongside the local Jews there. This cemetery was not deliberately destroyed after the Holocaust, but was simply forgotten and left to decay through the Soviet era before being registered as a protected heritage site in 1996.
